text:
andrew: FYI — auto-failover to eu-west this morning caused a SNAT/conntrack saturation on the egress NATs. We saw ~40% of requests 502ing and a sharp GPU warm-pool spike as retries hit fallback region.
meera: Ugh. Any conntrack logs or exact error?
andrew: Logs show repeated "nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet" across 3 nodes. Sample from node-12:
```
[  +0.000000] nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet.
ESTABLISHED src=10.0.2.5 dst=35.195.1.12 sport=52000 dport=443 packets=412 bytes=51234
...
```
sasha: Were connections sticky to origin IPs or did routing shuffle clients between egress IPs?
andrew: Route policy pinned by GeoDNS -> eu-west but when eu-west capacity hit, we fallback to pooled fallback that uses shared NATs. That pooled NAT ran out.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-397 (priority=P2)
meera: Short term: can we bump nf_conntrack_max and increase ephemeral ports on the NAT hosts? Command I used in test: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`
sasha: Short-term increase helps but it's a band-aid. We should avoid cross-region retries that multiply connections. Two proposals:
  1) Per-region SNAT pools + per-request region affinity so failover doesn't shift client source IPs (reduce conntrack blowup).
  2) Introduce an egress-proxy layer (L7) for expensive GPU requests — keep a stable outbound IP per-session and avoid backend retries from different NATs.
ops-runner: Cost note: adding dedicated NAT pools per-region will add ~2-3x NAT IPs/elastic ip charges for low-traffic regions; estimate +$6k/mo if we reserve for all APAC/EU shards. Is that acceptable vs. potential SLO hits?
meera: Also look at connection reuse and keepalive timeouts on GPU clients. Lowering keepalive can free conntrack entries faster.
andrew: Agree. For immediate mitigation I'm going to: 1) increase nf_conntrack_max on the 3 saturated NAT nodes, 2) flip fallback policy to prefer local-region warm-pools (even if slower) to avoid cross-region NAT churn, 3) start a task to prototype per-region SNAT pools.
sasha: I'll file an RFC for egress-proxy + region-affinity; include cost model and regression tests simulating failover churn.
ops-runner: Ping me for cost breakdown — we should include in RFC.
infra-bot: Deploy hook: rolling update queued for node-12 nat-worker at 1718203800 by andrew.
andrew: rolling update done on node-12, monitoring now. Will post follow-up in ~15m. :eyes:
